# Wallin & Klarich

> > Southern California criminal defense law firm serving Orange County, Los Angeles, Riverside, and San Bernardino with over 40 years of experience in criminal law, DUI defense, sex crimes, and expungement services.

Wallin & Klarich is a prominent California criminal defense firm led by attorneys Paul Wallin, Stephen Klarich, and Matthew B. Wallin. The firm specializes in defending clients against felony charges, sex crimes, DUI offenses, and helping individuals clear their criminal records through expungement and record sealing procedures.

## Key Topics

- Criminal defense in California
- DUI defense and felony DUI charges
- Sex crimes and PC 288 offenses
- Expungement and record clearing
- Felony reduction to misdemeanor (PC 17b)
- Orange County criminal law
- Sex offender registration requirements
- Child custody and criminal records
- Drug possession and sales charges
- Grand theft (PC 487)
- Criminal appeals process
- Prescription fraud defense
- Domestic violence cases
- Statute of limitations
- Southern California legal representation
